title: First Salon Visit in Azizi Riviera: Booking Checklist | Aurora
heading: Your first beauty salon visit in Azizi Riviera: a booking checklist
description: Plan your first visit to Aurora Beauty Lounge in Azizi Riviera, Meydan. Choose a service, prepare your questions and check your appointment details.
imageAlt: Facial treatment photograph from Aurora’s existing website gallery
imageNote: Johan authorized using existing salon-website photos on 2026-10-16. Existing VIP Facial gallery photograph selected; no AI image generated.
intro: Booking your first appointment at a beauty salon is easier when you know what to ask. At Aurora Beauty Lounge by Tolou, the salon is located at Azizi Riviera 40, Shop 10, Meydan, Dubai. This practical checklist helps you choose what to enquire about, share your preferences and check the details before you arrive.

sections.heading: Begin with the appointment you actually want
paragraphs: Start with your main reason for visiting rather than trying to book everything at once. You might be exploring lash extensions, eyebrow lamination, a facial or a manicure and pedicure enquiry. Browse the salon’s service overview, then note the exact service name you would like to discuss.

If you are unsure between two options, explain your preferences before selecting an appointment. Tell the team whether you are new to that service or returning for maintenance. Ask them to clarify what the selected appointment includes; similar names should not be treated as interchangeable.
sections.label: Explore Aurora’s service overview

sections.heading: Describe your preferences clearly
paragraphs: A clear description is more helpful than a single word such as natural or glamorous. For lashes or brows, explain the style you are interested in and ask which consultation is appropriate. A reference image can help communicate an idea, but it is not a promise that an identical result will be suitable or achievable.

Mention existing lash extensions, recent beauty appointments or other details relevant to the service you are enquiring about. If you have ingredient concerns or have previously reacted to a beauty product, raise those directly with the team before booking and ask what information or assessment they require.

sections.heading: Check duration and preparation with the team
paragraphs: Ask how much time to set aside for your chosen service, including any discussion before the appointment. If you want more than one service, confirm whether they need separate time slots and how the order of appointments will work. Do not assume a combination can always be fitted into a short visit.

Ask for the preparation instructions for the exact appointment you choose. The right instructions depend on the service, so avoid applying general advice from an unrelated treatment. If you are booking around work, travel or an event, explain that when asking about timings.

sections.heading: Confirm the booking details before travelling
paragraphs: Use Aurora’s existing online booking page to explore the available appointments. Review the service name, appointment date and time, and the price displayed for your selection before confirming. If any detail is unclear, contact the salon rather than relying on an older screenshot or a previous visit.

Keep your booking confirmation and check the provider’s current change or cancellation terms. An enquiry is not automatically a confirmed appointment. If you have only sent a WhatsApp question, wait for the team to confirm the arrangements before planning your journey.
sections.label: Check appointments on Aurora’s booking page

sections.heading: Find the salon in Azizi Riviera, Meydan
paragraphs: The salon’s address is Azizi Riviera 40, Shop 10, Meydan, Dubai. Use both the building and shop number when checking directions. Allow enough time to find the entrance, particularly if this is your first visit to the community.

Before leaving, keep three things handy: your appointment confirmation, the exact address and any questions you still want to ask. If you need practical arrival information, contact Aurora beforehand. A little preparation lets you focus on discussing your preferences when you reach the salon.
sections.label: Visit our Azizi Riviera salon location page

intro: Already wearing lash extensions and wondering which appointment to choose next? Aurora Beauty Lounge by Tolou lists Volume Lash Infill Extensions among its services. sections.heading: Start with your previous appointment, not an assumed maintenance interval
paragraphs: Tell the salon when your extensions were applied or last maintained and whether the appointment was at Aurora or elsewhere. If you have the previous service name, include it. A date and a service name give the team more useful context than saying that your lashes are simply due for a top-up.

Do not assume that a particular number of days automatically qualifies you for an infill. Ask how Aurora assesses the existing set and whether the appointment you are considering is appropriate. The salon needs to confirm its own requirements; this guide does not set a maintenance interval or a minimum amount of remaining extensions.

sections.heading: Describe what is on your lashes now
paragraphs: Explain whether you know the style or type of extensions currently applied. If you do not know, say so rather than selecting a label that may be inaccurate. Mention whether you are enquiring about maintaining the same style or discussing a change.

For example, a useful enquiry could read: “I currently have extensions applied at another salon on [date]. I would like to keep a similar look. Which appointment should I discuss before booking?” This is a message outline, not an example of an Aurora customer or a promise that another salon’s work can be infilled.

sections.heading: Ask how existing work affects the service choice
paragraphs: An infill appointment and a new set should not be treated as interchangeable bookings. Ask the team whether it can assess your existing extensions, which information it needs first and whether an in-person discussion is required. If removal or a different service might be relevant, have that clarified before choosing your appointment.

Keep questions about products, sensitivities or previous reactions separate and explicit. Raise any discomfort or concern directly before booking instead of assuming a routine infill will address it. The team can explain its booking process and tell you what further professional advice may be needed.

paragraphs: If you want to discuss a different finish, identify the change: a softer overall appearance, a different emphasis or simply a return to the style you previously liked. Ask how much time to set aside for the agreed appointment and request preparation and aftercare instructions for that service.
